cases.name: Heidi M. Chace
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Heidi graduated from Old Colony Regional Vocational High School where she played basketball. She enjoyed going to fairs and carnivals and loved animals."
cases.narrative: Authorities found Chace’s body with significant trauma to her face, blood throughout the house, and a hammer “saturated in blood that had hair on it,” in a “particularly violent and vicious crime scene,” said Bristol County Assistant District Attorney Caleb Weiner.
